column1: # How long one agent action should take, in seconds. agent-watch.sh flags
# SLOW the moment an action is still running past its time.
# Each line: a regular expression, a tab, the seconds. It is matched against
# "<tool name> <command>" (the command is a Bash call's command line, empty
# for other tools). The first line that matches wins, so put specific lines
# above general ones. A game adds its own lines in docs/team/action-times.tsv
# (same format); those are read first and win.
